items.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Question
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: Eaton Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Factory Ramp
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) trades near $390 a share, about 39.7 times the adjusted earnings it made over the past twelve months. That basis is normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, meant to sit closer to the analyst-consensus basis than a GAAP figure would, though the two adjusted measures are not defined identically. On that figure alone the stock looks dear. But it prices a year Eaton has already finished.

items.title: How Much Upside Can ETN Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: Data center sales are not supposed to grow like this inside a century-old industrial. Yet Eaton's sales to the segment surged about 65% last quarter. The company is aggressively reframing its business as an unparalleled portfolio from grid to chip to capture this demand. This is not the slow-growth electrical supplier many investors still imagine.
